reason: I've set layouts from store walks for years and they work well enough. I'm not putting PHP 75,000 and our CCTV footage in the hands of a new company that has no results to show me.
objection: They have no track record and they'd be filming our customers for analytics. A template and a counsel opinion they paid for won't protect us if the NPC comes knocking, and I'm the one who has to answer to the owner.
would_change_my_mind: A chain I know in the Philippines telling me it worked, and our own lawyer signing off on the privacy side.
